This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Uttam Kumar Adhikari, Vishal Adhikari, with the prayer to quash the summoning order dated 2.2.2023 passed by Judicial Magistrate, Pharenda, District Maharajganj, in Complaint Case No. 2345 of 2022, Om Prakash Sahni vs. Uttam Kumar Adhikari and others, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., P.S. -

sentences.text: At the very outset learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant no.1/Uttam Kumar Adhikari has already been arrested and as such the present petition in so far he is concerned, be dismissed not pressed.
5. The present petition in so far as the applicant no.1 is concerned stands dismissed.
6. Thus the application survives for the applicant no. 2/Vishal Adhikari only.

7. Learned counsel for the applicants states that the purpose of the applicant no. 2 would suffice if an order is passed directing the trial court to decide his bail application, as expeditiously as possible.

He further states that although the prayer has been made for quashing of the summoning order and the proceedings of the case but he does not press the same.
8.

Learned counsel for the State has no objection of aforesaid arguments of learned counsel for the applicant no. 2.
9.
In view of the above, the prayer for quashing of proceedings/summoning order is dismissed as not pressed.

10. However, in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the limited prayer of learned counsel for the applicant no.2 , it is directed that if the accused-applicant no.
2/Vishal Adhikari surrenders before the trial court and applies for bail within two weeks from today,
the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against him.

11. It it clarified that if the accused-applicant no. 2/Vishal Adhikari does not appear before the court concerned by the said date, the court concerned shall proceed against him in accordance with law.
12.
The present application is disposed of.
